mkdir -p /tmp/dp-august-preview && soffice -env:UserInstallation=file:///tmp/dp-august-preview/profile --headless --convert-to odt --outdir /tmp/dp-august-preview data/nic2-2003/codebooks/foreign-policy-indices-august.doc && python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import zipfile,re
p=Path('"'"'/tmp/dp-august-preview/foreign-policy-indices-august.odt'"'"')
with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as source, zipfile.ZipFile(p.with_name('"'"'fixed.odt'"'"'),'"'"'w'"'"') as target:
 for info in source.infolist():
  data=source.read(info.filename)
  if info.filename=='"'"'styles.xml'"'"':
   text=data.decode()
   text,n=re.subn(r'"'"'<text:date\b[^>]*>.*?</text:date>'"'"','"'"'<text:date style:data-style-name="N129" text:date-value="2004-08-01" text:fixed="true">8/1/2004</text:date>'"'"',text)
   assert n==1
   data=text.encode()
  target.writestr(info,data)
' && soffice -env:UserInstallation=file:///tmp/dp-august-preview/profile --headless --convert-to pdf --outdir /tmp/dp-august-preview /tmp/dp-august-preview/fixed.odt && cp /tmp/dp-august-preview/fixed.pdf data/nic2-2003/codebooks/foreign-policy-indices-august.pdf
